comment: The starved boar of the pasture above the village, which runs with the wolves and took the goat of Orrin (D-1353). Its body is two by two tiles, and it gores a front row foe. The level and the experience follow D-977, and a win rolls the gold from the low gold to the high gold (D-1157). PR-30 tunes each number. Its name is a common noun, so a battle line writes it in lower case after the start (D-1358).
